# disconnect_ton_connect_session()

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.Client.disconnect_ton_connect_session`

## Signature

```python
async def disconnect_ton_connect_session(session_id: int, body: Optional[bytes] = None) -> bool: ...
```

## Documentation

Close a TON Connect session.

**Available to:** User accounts.

### Parameters

- **`session_id`** (`int`)
  Unique identifier of the TON Connect session to close.

- **`body`** (`bytes`, *optional*)
  Encrypted body of the disconnect event, created by your own TON Connect code; omit it if the session
  has already been closed. Use [`get_ton_connect_session_next_event_id`](get_ton_connect_session_next_event_id.md) to get
  the identifier of the event.

### Returns

`bool`: True on success.

### Example

```python
await app.disconnect_ton_connect_session(session.id, body)
```
